scope: User-authorized follow-up beyond issue10 unchanged-policy experiment
format: Retain exact signed-int4 prepack and BF16 transposed G128 scales for this first screen
rounding_amendment: Before candidate execution, arbitrary-scale synthetic testing exposed original BF16 dequantization truncation, confirmed by an identity-matrix probe. Only the new policies explicitly round FP32 scale products to nearest-even BF16. Keep candidate reference thresholds unchanged; retain the original truncating path as a control. Tile and rounding changes are evaluated jointly.
numerical_gates: Original frozen reference atol=rtol=0.01, compatibility/batch separation atol=rtol=0.015625, exact same-input repeatability and canary/noninterference invariants unchanged
warmup: Balanced blocks for minimum 1 second; require three consecutive >=100ms windows with each arm median max/min <=1.01; cap at 10 seconds, otherwise unstable
measurement: At least 30 balanced blocks, two reversed shape-order process starts; retain raw timing, block-relative paired effects and bootstrap intervals; no CPU references or disk writes inside timed stage
selection: Require repeatable >=3% whole-adapter improvement beyond measured drift before further candidate gates; original native and oneDNN both retained as controls
later_gates: Additional middle/late-layer operands and immutable integrated memory budget, model-output/replay/state gates, paired16K/65K auto and KVarN service trials, then MTP2/images before recommendation
